gold_sql: SELECT name FROM datasets ORDER BY name
SELECT count(*) AS version_count FROM dataset_versions
SELECT split, count(*) AS sample_count FROM training_memberships GROUP BY split ORDER BY split
SELECT mv.version, mr.metrics_json FROM model_runs mr JOIN model_versions mv ON mv.id = mr.model_version_id ORDER BY mv.version
SELECT m.structure_type, p.absolute_error FROM predictions p JOIN molecules m ON m.molecule_id = p.molecule_id ORDER BY p.absolute_error DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT dv.version, m.structure_type, count(*) AS sample_count FROM dataset_versions dv JOIN training_memberships tm ON tm.dataset_version_id = dv.id JOIN molecules m ON m.molecule_id = tm.molecule_id GROUP BY dv.version, m.structure_type ORDER BY dv.version, m.structure_type

SELECT mv.version, m.structure_type, avg(p.absolute_error) AS mae FROM model_versions mv JOIN model_runs mr ON mr.model_version_id = mv.id JOIN predictions p ON p.model_run_id = mr.id JOIN molecules m ON m.molecule_id = p.molecule_id GROUP BY mv.version, m.structure_type ORDER BY mv.version, m.structure_type
SELECT e.name, dv.version FROM experiments e JOIN dataset_versions dv ON dv.id = e.dataset_version_id ORDER BY e.name
SELECT count(*) AS fused_count FROM training_memberships tm JOIN molecular_features mf ON mf.molecule_id = tm.molecule_id WHERE mf.is_fused_ring = true
SELECT DISTINCT s.molecule_id FROM msms_spectra s LEFT JOIN annotations a ON a.molecule_id = s.molecule_id WHERE a.id IS NULL ORDER BY s.molecule_id
